name: Akuma Shitsuji to Kuroi Neko
source:
A real fantasy spun with 13 butlers.
You will be the master of the butlers and save the world with them.
While reading the worries and pasts of the butlers, the mysteries of the world will be solved.
translation:
一个由13位管家编织而成的真实奇幻故事。
你将成为管家的主人，与他们一起拯救世界。
在阅读管家们的烦恼和过去的同时，世界的谜团也将被解开。
